summary: std/amqp: `amqp.decode` and the frame and message decoders built on it refuse a list, map or array declaring more elements than its body has bytes, or more than 65,536, as go-amqp v1.7.0 does
details: `amqp.decode` and the frame and message decoders built on it refuse a list, map or array declaring more elements than its body has bytes, or more than 65,536, as go-amqp v1.7.0 does; an array was exempt from the first check, so a value of a few bytes could ask for billions of elements of a type that takes no bytes and grow without bound (10 bytes asking for 10 million: 244 MB before, refused at once now). Affected: 0.41.0 to 0.51.1.
changelog: - Security (std/amqp, every backend): `amqp.decode` and the frame and message decoders built on it refuse a list, map or array declaring more elements than its body has bytes, or more than 65,536, as go-amqp v1.7.0 does; an array was exempt from the first check, so a value of a few bytes could ask for billions of elements of a type that takes no bytes and grow without bound (10 bytes asking for 10 million: 244 MB before, refused at once now). Affected: 0.41.0 to 0.51.1.
